versions.content: Selecting OBD 3 Byte DTCs for readiness group filter If Dem_SetDTCFilterByReadinessGroup is called with DTCFormat equal to DEM_- DTC_FORMAT_OBD_3BYTE and DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to True, the Dem shall use the DTCs configured via DemDtcValue3Byte as filter target.
